invariant.statement: A lending venue must not liquidate tokenized-equity collateral against a price that keeps updating while the underlying US equity market is CLOSED, with no market-status guard.

verdict.reason: The price account updated 3341× while the US equity market was CLOSED (max gap 4 min) with no market-status halt — so liquidations execute against a price the regulated market never printed.

reproduce.level1_offline: node verify.mjs <claim.json>           # re-execute the verdict from embedded observations (zero-dep, no RPC)
reproduce.level2_onchain: node verify.mjs <claim.json> --fetch   # re-pull the observations from Solana and confirm they are authentic
